findings.text: follow-on: the clause-bearing allow-list CLAUSE_STATES (reckon/crew/ticker.py:271-286) does not carry lift-granted/lift-ended/lift-in-force, so _reason returns an empty string and the naming clause the plan requires the follower to print is never rendered - a coordinator watching the pane sees "lift-granted" or "lift-ended" with no group, multiple or end cause. ticker.py is outside this node's fence, so the row is correct but its naming is invisible; adding the three lift states to CLAUSE_STATES is the follow-up that makes the clause visible.

follow-on: the durability assertion assert isinstance(format_watch_transition(row), str) (and the Ticker().render(row) line at :193) passes for any rendering that does not raise, so it cannot redden on the regression it exists to catch - a ticker that drops the clause, as current main does, still yields a str. Assert that the rendered line carries the state word and the end-cause clause, or the guard is not a guard.

follow-on: end_cause re-derives the four-cause ladder rather than calling budget_lift's own end logic, so the producer's account of why a lift ended is a second implementation that can drift from the resolver budget_lift.effective_budget reads; the new cause vocabulary is genuinely new, but the ladder duplicates budget_lift.py:667 and budget_lift.py:649-664.

item_verdicts.diff: one commit 587168a7690d3d025a2e90e6a7e81180102248aa -> a44b5105fd0482d4a3bed1b20fb31cdfc0c237b1 adds reckon/crew/lift_watch.py (246 lines), a 35-line _sweep_lift_rows helper plus its single call in reckon/crew/recovery.py watch_ticker, tests/test_follower_names_a_lift.py (283 lines) and the 67-line evidence fragment, with no file outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_follower_names_a_lift.py plus every watch/follow/ticker file at base and head; the two arms are recorded (gate_base.log 13 failed / 494 passed / 2 skipped, gate_head.log 13 failed / 503 passed / 2 skipped, identical 13-id failure sets) and the focused pair closes 47 passed EXIT=0 (focused_after.log); the assertions check the row's own fields and that it renders without raising, not that the naming clause reaches the rendered line.
item_verdicts.goal: the producer-side deliverable is complete - reckon/crew/lift_watch.py:117-183 writes one lift-granted row naming the group, form, multiple, scope and id and one lift-ended row naming one of reset/at/ceiling/clear - but the goal's "naming what ended it" half is invisible to a reader: reckon/crew/ticker.py:2066 returns an empty clause for any state outside CLAUSE_STATES, and none of lift-granted/lift-ended/lift-in-force is in it, so a follower renders the state word only.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, it records the commit a44b5105, the changed paths, the two-arm baseline_suite and after_suite with their log paths, the negative-control log, and a landing line, and it discloses the ticker follow-on honestly.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch fenced the node to reckon/crew/lift_watch.py, reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_follower_names_a_lift.py and the plan fragment and figures dir; git diff --name-only 587168a7690d3d025a2e90e6a7e81180102248aa a44b5105fd0482d4a3bed1b20fb31cdfc0c237b1 lists exactly the two production modules, the new test and the fragment (docs/evidence/fragments/a-window-paces-the-lane/the-follower-names-a-lift.html), all inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control (skip the lift-ended row when ended by clear) is applied on a scratch copy and reddens two cases (tests/test_follower_names_a_lift.py:180 and :242, EXIT=1), so the clear-case guard is load-bearing; docked because tests/test_follower_names_a_lift.py:192-193 asserts only isinstance(..., str), which cannot fail on the clause being dropped.
justifications.evidence: the gate log pair is two real arms at base 587168a and the head worktree (gate_base.log 13 failed/494 passed, gate_head.log 13 failed/503 passed, identical 13-id failure sets), the focused pair closes 47 passed EXIT=0, and negative_control.log reddens the clear case EXIT=1; docked because the head arm names a working tree rather than the commit, and the follower claim the done-when measures ("renders without raising") is weaker than the plan's "naming".
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/lift_watch.py follows the module idiom (from __future__ annotations, __all__, mapping-based helpers) with no plan, stage, ticket or author label in any symbol, docstring or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/lift_watch.py:117-183 writes both rows and the naming clause, and tests/test_follower_names_a_lift.py drives them, but reckon/crew/ticker.py:2066 suppresses the clause for the lift states so the plan's "the follower prints ... naming what ended it" is not reached on current main; the state word still shows the lift's start and end.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/lift_watch.py:87 end_cause reuses budget_lift._parse_stamp, _reset_observed, _in_force, ceilings and published_readings, but re-derives a four-way ladder that duplicates budget_lift's own end logic (budget_lift.py:667 _end_moment already names time/reset, and budget_lift.py:649-664 tests the same cleared/ceiling/at/reset set), and _aware is re-implemented from budget_lift.py:936.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 587168a7690d3d025a2e90e6a7e81180102248aa a44b5105fd0482d4a3bed1b20fb31cdfc0c237b1 lists only reckon/crew/lift_watch.py, reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_follower_names_a_lift.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-window-paces-the-lane/the-follower-names-a-lift.html, every one inside the dispatch's declared write paths.
